title: Watch My Videos Or Else
text:

insight: Couples share random videos as tiny bids for attention; not watching them feels comically personal.
visual: Aachu wraps Zuv in a gentle mock-serious cuddle squeeze while he holds a phone full of unwatched video messages.

title: Your Life Needs My Nonsense
text:
imagine how boring your life
would be if you didn't have
me to annoy you
insight: The annoying partner is often also the warmth, noise, and entertainment of the relationship.
visual: Aachu pops into Zuv's quiet moment with a handmade heart prop, proudly owning her role as his favorite interruption.
